summary: Studio City International Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, its unaudited third-quarter 2026 earnings release. Total operating revenues were US$163.3 million versus US$182.5 million a year earlier, with casino contract revenue of US$66.9 million and non-gaming revenues of US$96.4 million. Adjusted EBITDA fell to US$65.5 million from US$78.1 million, and the net loss attributable to the company narrowed to US$13.1 million, or US$0.07 per ADS. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly results announcement.
